metadata.case_name: ALI MEHBOOB v. YUN KWAN CONSTRUCTION ENGINEERING LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Construction site labourer and 24-ton truck driver (also worked as night-time security guard)
plaintiff.occupation_after: Office messenger (from 11 June 2014) and later light goods vehicle driver with SK Recycling

injuries.description: Fractured right distal radius (intra-articular fracture of the right distal radius)
source: X-ray showed him to have sustained a fractured right distal radius.
characterized the injury as an intra-articular fracture of the right distal radius.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at other specified part of wrist or hand level

manifestations.description: Pain in the right wrist when carrying heavy objects; constant mild aching of the right wrist even during sleep
Pain on movement and exertion of the right wrist
Active range of right wrist flexion 60 degrees and extension 50 degrees
Right power grip 18 kg (reduced grip strength)
Slight radial shortening and slight irregularity of the joint surface with slight dorsal tilting of the articular surface and slight deformity in the joint line
Difficulty driving a loaded truck because of heavy steering column and weakness of grip; unable to lift heavy objects
Pain increases to 5/10 on NPRS upon lifting objects between 2kg to 3kg and on certain wrist movements; sensitivity to cold weather

treatments_received: X-ray and diagnosis of fractured right distal radius
Closed reduction and short arm slab
Occupational therapy (work capacity evaluation and rehabilitation training)
treatments_future: Wrist arthroscopy (explained on 11 December 2013 but considered and declined by the plaintiff)

losses.description: Residual pain and stiffness of the right wrist with slight articular deformity, reduced range of motion and reduced grip strength

Reduced ability to perform previous employment (heavy truck driving and construction site labour) because of inability to manoeuvre the steering wheel of a loaded truck and inability to lift heavy objects

comparable_cases.case_name: Li Kwok Kee v China HK Wah Lee Ltd
comparable_cases.injury_description: Wrist fracture injuries (after open reduction and internal fixation, recovered with no deformity but with two minor scars, residual pain and stiffness)

comparable_cases.case_name: Yip Mau Leung v University of Hong Kong
comparable_cases.injury_description: Wrist injury (falling below the category of serious injury)
